For a more reliable rootless apply flow, start Shizuku with Wireless debugging and grant MTZ Studio permission. The Shizuku + BAK Converter path can import to the local Themes library without root.
Export the diagnostics package first, then attach it when contacting @Glorioustr.
Pair with a wireless debugging code
For Android 11 and newer. Keep the phone connected to Wi-Fi and use split screen so Settings and Shizuku/Shevery can remain visible together.
Enable Developer options, then enable USB debugging and Wireless debugging.
Open Wireless debugging and tap “Pair device with pairing code”. Keep the six-digit code on screen.
Return to Shizuku/Shevery, choose pairing by code, enter the displayed code, and confirm.
Tap Start in Shizuku/Shevery. Return to MTZ Studio and allow its Shizuku permission request.

Xiaomi tip: the steps above are sufficient for normal pairing. Only if authorization fails and your device exposes it, enable “USB debugging (Security settings)”. Restart the service after every phone reboot.
